subject: Post-demo: proposed export plan for access logs & PII evidence
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sylvia Turner <sylvia.turner@greenwave.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-04T09:12:05Z
Subject: Post-demo: proposed export plan for access logs & PII evidence

Hi Sylvia —

Great to meet you and John this morning. Quick recap from our demo and the next steps we agreed on around audit evidence for your compliance review:

Summary of ask (as I understood it)
- 90-day access audit for the production tenant(s): who accessed model inference/embeddings and when
- Exportable format suitable for internal auditors (CSV or Parquet) plus a JSONL schema mapping
- Ability to redact or pseudonymize PII fields (email, user_id, prompt_text) before delivery
- EU data residency confirmation and retention policy details for audit logs

What we propose to deliver (draft plan)
1) Sample export covering a rolling 30-day window (sanitized) so your audit team can validate format and fields
2) A schema document explaining each column and timestamp normalization (UTC + timezone tag)
3) Two redaction options: full redact (remove value, keep event metadata) and pseudonymize (hashed user id) with a short technical note on reversibility (none)
4) Instructions and a secure delivery link to a signed GCS object (or alternate S3 endpoint)

Questions for you
- Can you confirm the specific PII elements your auditors want removed versus pseudonymized? (e.g. only user_email, or also prompt_text)
- Do you need exports in Parquet for analytics or is compressed CSV OK?
- Any special SLA for delivery (we can hit 3 business days for a sanitized sample)

I will loop in Neha (SE) and Marissa (CS) to scope the technical extraction and timeline.

Thanks — I’ll wait for your confirmation and will schedule the export job after we align on the exact fields.

Best,
Rafael
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Sylvia Turner <sylvia.turner@greenwave.com>

Date: 2026-08-04T10:03:30Z
Subject: Re: Post-demo: proposed export plan for access logs & PII evidence

Thanks Rafael — that matches our needs. A few clarifications:

1) Scope and retention
- We need a 90-day window for the initial audit; for ongoing retention we require evidence that audit logs are retained for at least 13 months in the EU region. Please confirm the retention policy and whether logs can be set to immutable for that period.

2) PII handling
- Required: user_email, user_id, and any free-text prompts that might contain customer-identifying data must be treated.
- Preferred approach: pseudonymize user_id and redact prompt_text. However, for legal reasons we may ask for a reversible tokenization under strict controls later — for now please provide a non-reversible hash option and explain the hashing algorithm.

3) Format
- CSV is fine for now; Parquet would be useful for our analytics team but not required for the first sample. Please include a schema file.

4) Delivery / evidence format
- We prefer a signed GCS link (EU region) or an encrypted S3 presigned URL. The export should include a manifest with checksums.

Procurement: Please confirm if any additional commercial paperwork or DPA addendum is needed for delivering export access.

If you can deliver the sanitized 30-day sample first (as you suggested) that will help us validate format and redaction. Thanks — please include Neha and Marissa on follow-ups.

Best,
Sylvia Turner
Head of Information Security, GreenWave Finance
sylvia.turner@greenwave.com

Subject: Re: FW: Post-demo: proposed export plan for access logs & PII evidence

Rafael / Marissa —

We can provide exactly what Sylvia requested. Technical notes and proposed plan below.

Audit-export schema (high level)
- event_ts (ISO8601 UTC)
- request_id (string)
- user_id (string)
- user_email (string)
- resource (string)
- action (string - e.g., generate, embedding, list_models)
- model_version (string)
- latency_ms (int)
- prompt_text (string)
- response_token_count (int)

Redaction / pseudonymization options
- Full redact: prompt_text replaced with "[REDACTED]"; user_email removed, user_id removed
- Pseudonymize: user_id hashed with HMAC-SHA256 using a tenant-specific key (non-reversible without key), user_email partially masked (first 3 chars + ****)

Export formats and delivery
- We'll generate a sanitized CSV (gzip) and a companion JSONL schema file (audit_schema_v2.jsonl).
- Delivery: upload to EU-region GCS bucket, create time-limited signed URL, include manifest.json with SHA256 checksums.

Retention / immutability
- Logs are retained for 13 months by default for customers in the EU region; we can enable WORM-style (immutable) retention for the export bucket for the agreed period — legal sign-off required.

ETA and next steps
- I can produce a 30-day sanitized sample (redact prompt_text, pseudonymize user_id) within 48 hours.
- For the full 90-day audit export we need a formal request via the portal (one-time export job) — estimated turnaround 3 business days after request approval.

Command-line example (internal)
- export job: redwoodctl audit export --tenant gw-prod --start 2026-05-05 --end 2026-08-03 --format csv --redact prompt_text --pseudonymize user_id --dest gs://redwood-exports-gw-eu/exports/2026-08-04/

I attached the audit_schema_v2.jsonl (schema and sample records) and will start the sample run once Rafael confirms deliverable and Sylvia confirms redaction choice.

Neha Kapoor
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
